title: Karger contraction survival lower bound
statement:
Let $s$ be a state of the contraction process, consisting of a multigraph $G$ together with a distinguished cut $C$, and let $n$ be a natural number with $2 \le n$. Suppose that $C$ is a minimum cut of $G$, that $C$ has positive size, and that $G$ has exactly $n$ vertices. Then the recursive survival probability that $C$ survives $n-2$ successive uniformly random edge-occurrence contractions is at least
\[
  \frac{2}{n(n-1)}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: C is a minimum cut of G
the cut C has positive size
